rationale: Jamie is building vertical AI SaaS at Twigg AI, and Lydia's deep expertise in developer experience, JavaScript/TypeScript tooling, and AI-assisted coding (Claude Code at Anthropic) could unlock both technical strategy and go-to-market angles for an AI product aimed at developers. Lydia's track record bridging technical education with product-level tooling at Vercel and Bun—plus her conviction that great DX unlocks ecosystem adoption—aligns with the kind of leverage a nascent vertical AI company needs.
intro_message: Jamie Borland, meet Lydia Hallie — she's a developer experience and AI tooling specialist at Anthropic (Claude Code team) with a proven ability to drive adoption through technical education and product strategy, and could be a valuable thought partner for Twigg AI's positioning and developer narrative.
